title: One-step transition probability
statement: Let $G$ be a regular multigraph of positive degree $D$, and let $u,v$ be vertices of $G$. The probability that a one-step walk from $u$ ends at $v$ is the multiplicity of the edge from $u$ to $v$, divided by $D$.
hypotheses_covered: $G$ is a regular multigraph of positive degree $D$
